Notice Of Motion For Default Prove Up Hearing
Off Calendar Jan-31-2013 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.

Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq., specially appearing for Plaintiff, State Farm Mutual Automobile Ins. Co.
Order Granting waiver of Witness Requirement of Hearing on Application for Default Prove-up, on file.
No appearance by defaulted defendant(s) Roshon Antoinette Murray and Kevin M. Robinson.
Default of Defendant(s) has been duly entered.
Court ordered Defendants Does 1-10 dismissed without prejudice.

After Evidence and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against Defaulted Defendant(s) as follows:
Under 7. Other: Pursuant o CVC 17151 and 17155, the judgment against KEVIN M ROBINSON is enforceable only to the extent of the minimum insurance requirements at the time of the accident which were $15,000.00 per person to a maximum of $30,000.00 for personal injuries. In this case $18,900.00 is the amount enforceable against KEVIN M ROBINSON.

Damages: $29,130.25
Pre-Judgment Interest: $782.60
Costs: $555.00
Total Judgment in the amount of $30,467.85
Judgment signed in open court.
